article.title: NFL EDGE Saturday Morning Brief
article.dek: Detroit lost its best defender for the season, Arizona is likely on its fourth quarterback in four weeks, and two lines moved a full point overnight.

items.headline: Detroit lost its best defender for the season
paragraphs: Aidan Hutchinson is done for the year. He tore the ACL in his right knee celebrating a sack in Detroit's win over New England in Munich last Sunday, and the Lions have put him on injured reserve.
This is Detroit's first game without him. He is their best pass rusher, and there is no replacing that in a week. The Lions host Tampa Bay on Sunday at 1:00 p.m. ET.

The line has not moved on the news yet. Detroit is still -5.5 on DraftKings, the same number as Friday evening. If your book has a Tampa Bay price you like, Check it now — the board may not have caught up to the news.
items.takeaway: Hutchinson is out for the season, and Detroit -5.5 has not moved since Friday. Check the Tampa Bay price before the market reacts.

sources.label: Detroit Free Press — Hutchinson: 'That's the last time I go airborne'

items.headline: Arizona is likely on its fourth quarterback in four weeks
paragraphs: Carson Beck did not practice Friday. His back spasms flared up again, he is officially questionable, and he is considered unlikely to play Sunday at Kansas City.
Coach Mike LaFleur said the Cardinals are proceeding as if Josh Johnson will start. That would make Johnson Arizona's fourth starting quarterback in four weeks.

Here is the catch: the app still lists Beck as Arizona's expected starter. Do not trust the app's number on this game until the quarterback is settled. The final answer comes with the inactives, about 90 minutes before kickoff.
items.takeaway: Beck is unlikely to play and Josh Johnson is the likely starter, but the app still lists Beck. Check your price once Johnson is confirmed.

items.headline: Mayfield is trending the right way for Sunday
paragraphs: Baker Mayfield is officially questionable with a foot strain, but every sign points to him playing. He sat out Wednesday, practiced in a limited way Thursday and Friday, and looked good in Friday's practice.
Coach Todd Bowles said Mayfield is trending in the right direction to start Sunday at Detroit. If he cannot go, undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels is the emergency starter.
It is not final until the inactives come out, about 90 minutes before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff. Check the Tampa Bay price now, and check it again then.
items.takeaway: Mayfield looked good in Friday's practice and is expected to start, but the inactives settle it about 90 minutes before kickoff.

sources.label: NBC Sports — Baker Mayfield (foot) officially questionable

items.headline: Weather: rain in three spots, wind in Chicago and Kansas City
paragraphs: Rain is likely at kickoff in Chicago, Philadelphia, and at MetLife for Jaguars at Giants. Chicago gets 57 degrees with wind at 15 mph gusting to 23. Philadelphia gets 62 degrees and about 0.41 inches of rain. MetLife gets 56 degrees and about 0.19 inches.
Kansas City stays dry but windy: 48 degrees, mostly sunny, wind 15 mph gusting to 24. Carolina gets a light rain chance at 14 percent, and Buffalo is clear at 64 degrees.
That is the weather, plain and simple. It is not a totals edge, and it does not change what the app says. Note it, then bet the numbers.
items.takeaway: Rain likely in Chicago, Philadelphia, and at MetLife. Wind about 15 mph in Chicago and Kansas City. Mild everywhere else.

sections.title: What It Means for NFL EDGE

items.headline: How to read today's three cards
paragraphs: The cards are unchanged from Friday evening. Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline at -253, the most likely winner on the board. The app gives Jacksonville about a 72.5 percent chance, against about 71.7 percent needed to break even at that price.

Balanced is Jets +3 at -105, about a coin flip and the middle ground — a strong pick without paying too much. Value is Giants +6 at -110, barely over the line at about 52.5 percent against 52.4 percent needed.

Only the Jaguars price moved, and only a little. The moneyline is -253 on DraftKings this morning, cheaper than the -262 it showed Friday evening. A cheaper price on the same pick is a better price. If your book has Jacksonville cheaper still, Check it — the app runs your price back through the model and tells you bet or no bet.
items.takeaway: Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline -253, the most likely winner. Balanced is Jets +3 at -105, about a coin flip. Value is Giants +6 at -110, barely over the line.

items.headline: The app still thinks the big spreads are too fat, and it still bet none of them
paragraphs: Look at the gaps. The app has Kansas City winning by about 6, not 16.5. Buffalo by about 3.4, not 16.5. Chicago by about 0.2, not 11.5. Detroit by about 1.7, not 5.5.

Those are big disagreements with the market, and the app put none of those dogs on a card. A gap is a starting point, not a bet. The card is what the model and the evaluator agreed on after the full check.

If one of those dogs catches your eye at your book, do not just take it. Type the line and the price into Check and let the app run it back through the model and the evaluator. That is what Check is for.
items.takeaway: Big spreads, big model gaps, zero cards on the dogs. The gap alone is not the bet. Check your price.

items.headline: Handle vs. bets: two numbers that tell different stories
paragraphs: Every betting split shows two numbers. BET is the share of tickets, the count of bets. HND is the share of handle, the count of dollars. They often point the same way. When they do not, pay attention.

Here is a clearly labeled hypothetical example. Imagine a game where 80 percent of the bets are on the favorite, but only 55 percent of the money is. That means lots of small bets on the favorite, and fewer, bigger bets on the dog. The crowd and the bigger money disagree.

A disagreement like that is decision context, not a pick. It tells you where the price might move next, and it tells you to watch the line before you bet. It never tells you to fade the public on its own, and it never overrides what the app says about your price.
items.takeaway: When most bets are on one side and most of the money is on the other, the crowd and the bigger bettors disagree — and that disagreement is worth watching, not blindly following.

items.headline: Dallas came back a point, the Jets total jumped a point
paragraphs: Two real moves overnight. Dallas went from -8.5 to -7.5 against Tennessee, a full point toward the dog. The app has Tennessee essentially even in this game, so the market moved toward the app's number.
The Jets at Chargers total went from 41.5 to 42.5, a full point up. The app's total for that game sits near 46, so the market is still well short of the app's number — but the direction is up.

Everything else on the card held. Detroit is still -5.5, the Giants are still +6 at -110, the Jets are still +3 at -105, and the Jaguars moneyline only improved from -262 to -253 on DraftKings. Small price wiggles in Kansas City, Denver, and Chicago mean nothing on their own.
items.takeaway: Dallas moved a full point to -7.5 and the Jets-Chargers total moved a full point to 42.5. Everything else on the card held.

items.headline: Detroit has not moved on the Hutchinson news
paragraphs: The Hutchinson news has been out since Thursday, and Detroit is still -5.5 on DraftKings, the same number as Friday evening. The market has not reacted, or it decided the news was already in the price.

Either way, that is what the board shows this morning. If you like Tampa Bay at +5.5, Check it now — a good number today beats a hoped-for number on Sunday, because waiting lets the number drift the wrong way too.
items.takeaway: Detroit is still -5.5 even after losing Hutchinson for the season. If your book has Tampa Bay at a good price, Check it now.

items.headline: No games today — use the quiet day to check your prices
paragraphs: There are no NFL games today. Sunday is the slate, and the board refreshes every morning and evening, so the numbers you see now are not the numbers you will see tomorrow.

Two things are still open. Mayfield's foot and Arizona's quarterback both get their final answer with the inactives, about 90 minutes before kickoff on Sunday. If your book has a good number on Tampa Bay or on either side of Arizona at Kansas City right now and Check says bet, bet now. Waiting for a better number is only smart when you know what you are waiting for.
Check your prices today while it is quiet. Then check them again Sunday morning, after the board refreshes.
items.takeaway: No games today. Check your prices now while it is quiet, and check again Sunday morning after the board refreshes — Mayfield and Arizona's quarterback settle at the inactives.
